$comment: Golden oracle for the V1 global rating (PAF-9). Normative companion: docs/rating/v1-calibration.md. Consumed unchanged by T10 (PAF-10) regression tests.

approval.status: parameters approved by product owner (HITL, PAF-9 session)
approval.fixture_review: pending product-owner review of this file

formulas.reliability_factor: K(r) = 0.30 * (1 - 0.75 * r / 100), r = player's reliability_percent BEFORE the group

rules.rounding: single half-away-from-zero rounding of raw_delta to 2 decimals per player; -0.00 normalised to 0.00
rules.clamp: after rounding; at 0.00/7.00 out-of-range movement is impossible, in-range movement applies normally from the clamped value
rules.simultaneity: all four pre-group states are read before any player is updated
rules.ratable: match_type = competitive AND classification in (team_a, team_b, draw) AND result_status = confirmed
rules.non_ratable_effect: no rating event, no state change (mu, display, sigma, reliability, groups, highest, last_rating_at)
rules.score_margin: never an input; stored for statistics only
rules.league: league_id/community_id are provenance only; League standings never an input
rules.replay_order: ascending (played_at instant, game_group_id lowercase canonical UUID string)
rules.initialization: self-declared and creator-estimated levels initialise identically: mu = display = highest = level, sigma 1.00, reliability 10, groups 0
rules.account_claim: no rating event, user_id unchanged, rating history unchanged; clears is_provisional (account metadata, no rating effect); level change only if groups = 0

numeric_policy.two_decimal_fields: fixed-point decimal strings; compare exactly (to the cent)
numeric_policy.expected_score_and_raw_delta: decimal strings with up to 20 fractional digits (rounded from a 60-significant-digit computation); compare with absolute tolerance 1e-12
numeric_policy.integers: reliability_percent and confirmed_competitive_game_groups are JSON integers
numeric_policy.not_applicable: null for strengths/expected scores of non-ratable groups (no calculation, not E = 0)

cases.title: Expected win: stronger team wins
cases.description: Team A (strength 4.10) beats Team B (3.50). All players at 5 confirmed groups / 40%. Winners gain modestly, losers lose the same amount (same reliability). Sets 6-4 6-3.

cases.title: Upset: weaker team wins
cases.description: Same pre-state as GF-01, but Team B (weaker, 3.50) wins. Underdog gains (+0.14) are double the expected-win gains (+0.07) of GF-01; favourites lose more.

cases.title: Equal-strength Draw
cases.description: Both teams strength 4.000, result Draw (1-1 in sets, third set unfinished). E = 0.5 exactly, so every delta is exactly 0.00. Correct by design: a draw between equal teams carries no directional evidence. Reliability and group count still advance (+6 / +1) because the group is Confirmed Competitive.

cases.title: Weaker team draws stronger team
cases.description: Team A (3.10) draws Team B (4.10), strength gap 1.00. Draw is positive evidence for the weaker team: Team A gains, Team B loses.

cases.title: Different reliabilities in the same match (PRD §26 shape)
cases.description: Team A (3.90) beats stronger Team B (4.20). Same E for both Team A partners, but p1 (16%) gains more than p2 (82%). On Team B, p4 (28%) loses more than p3 (100%). Source of the AC4 worked explanations. Group sum is non-zero by design.

cases.title: First confirmed competitive group changes level
cases.description: Four freshly onboarded players (0 groups, 10%), levels initialised from self-declared 3.5/3.0/3.2/3.3. Equal strengths (3.250). Team A wins: winners +0.14, losers -0.14; reliability 10 -> 16, groups 0 -> 1. The first group already moves the level.

cases.title: Lower boundary 0.00 clamps; in-range movement resumes
cases.description: Step 1: Team A (p1 0.05, p2 0.00) loses to Team B. Rounded delta -0.10 would project p1 to -0.05 and p2 to -0.10; both clamp to 0.00 (applied -0.05 and 0.00). Reliability still advances. Step 2: same quartet, Team A wins; movement is applied from the clamped 0.00 values.

cases.title: Upper boundary 7.00 clamps
cases.description: Team A (p1 6.95, p2 7.00) beats Team B (6.50, 6.40). Rounded delta +0.09 projects p1 to 7.04 and p2 to 7.09; both clamp to 7.00 (applied +0.05 and 0.00). Reliability still advances. Losers move normally.

cases.title: Friendly: zero effect
cases.description: GF-01 pre-state and score, but match_type friendly (Confirmed). No rating event; mu, display, reliability, groups, highest, last_rating_at unchanged.

cases.title: Incomplete/Abandoned: zero effect
cases.description: Competitive, Confirmed, classification incomplete (fewer than two completed sets). No rating event; state unchanged.

cases.title: Pending: zero effect
cases.description: Competitive Team A win still in result_status pending. No rating event until it is Confirmed.

cases.title: Disputed: zero effect
cases.description: Competitive Team A win in result_status disputed. No rating event.

cases.title: Score-margin invariance: 6-0 6-0
cases.description: GF-01 pre-state, Team A wins 6-0 6-0. Rating outputs must equal GF-13b and GF-01 exactly.

cases.title: Score-margin invariance: 7-6 4-6 7-5
cases.description: GF-01 pre-state, Team A wins 7-6 4-6 7-5. Rating outputs must equal GF-13a and GF-01 exactly.

cases.title: Identical played_at: tiebreak by game_group_id
cases.description: Two groups of the same match share played_at. They are ingested in reverse order (…9000-000000000017 first) but must replay ascending by (played_at, game_group_id): …016 then …017. p1 and p3 play in both groups, so the second group uses their post-first-group mu and reliability. reverse_order_counterfactual shows the (wrong) result of replaying …017 first, proving the order matters.

reverse_order_counterfactual.note: NON-NORMATIVE. Final mu if …017 were (incorrectly) replayed before …016. Must NOT be produced by T10.

cases.title: Provisional players rate identically
cases.description: Same inputs as GF-06, but p1 and p3 are provisional players whose levels were creator-estimated. Every rating output equals GF-06.

cases.title: Account claim causes zero rating-history change
cases.description: p1 is provisional (creator estimate 3.0). Group 1, then p1 claims the account (same user_id, no level change), then group 2. Rating events and states must equal GF-16b, which has the same groups and no claim.

cases.title: Claim-invariance control: same groups, no claim
cases.description: Control for GF-16a: identical group sequence and pre-state levels, p1 is a normal self-declared player throughout. Rating events must equal GF-16a step-for-step (is_provisional / initialization_source differ by design and are not rating inputs).

cases.title: Very mismatched teams: logistic saturation
cases.description: Team A (6.70) vs Team B (0.50), gap 6.20. Step 1: expected win -> all deltas round to 0.00 (E_A ≈ 0.99921; win carries almost no information). Step 1: an expected result that is (correctly) invisible; reliability still advances. Step 2: the same quartet produces the upset; players are now at 16% (K = 0.264) and move ±0.26, close to the K ceiling. Worst case for any V1 group: |raw_delta| < K(10%) = 0.2775, so no player can ever move more than 0.28 in one group.

cases.title: Low-reliability player moves more than established players
cases.description: Equal strengths (4.000). Team A: p1 new (10%), p2 established (100%). Team B both 100%. Team A wins: p1 +0.14, everyone else ±0.04. Non-zero-sum by design (+0.18 / -0.08).

cases.title: Reliability schedule pin 10 -> 16 -> 22 -> 28 -> 34
cases.description: Four new players play four consecutive groups. Every player gains +6 reliability and +1 group per confirmed group regardless of win, loss or draw (group 2 is a loss for Team A; group 3 is a near-equal Draw, gap 0.10, moving only ±0.01; group 4 re-pairs partners p1+p3 vs p2+p4).

cases.title: 100% reliability still moves (×0.25)
cases.description: p1 (30 groups) and p3/p4 (15 and 40 groups) are at 100%: K = 0.075, a quarter of the base 0.30, so a win at equal strength still moves +0.04. p2 crosses 14 -> 15 groups (94% -> 100%) and uses its pre-group 94% (K = 0.0885).

cases.title: Exact half-cent ties round away from zero
cases.description: Equal strengths, all at 40% (K = 0.21), E = 0.5 exactly, so raw deltas are exactly +0.105 and -0.105. Half-away-from-zero gives +0.11 and -0.11 (symmetric). Rounding the projected mu instead (e.g. 3.995 for p3) would yield -0.10 for losers, which is NOT the approved rule. Naive binary floating point may compute 0.10499999… and fail this case.

cases.title: Partner strength matters (partner 5.00)
cases.description: p1 (4.00, 40%) with partner p2 (5.00) beats the same Team B (4.00/4.00). Compare GF-22a and GF-22b: a stronger partner raises own team strength, so the same win earns p1 less.

cases.title: Partner strength matters (partner 3.00)
cases.description: p1 (4.00, 40%) with partner p2 (3.00) beats the same Team B (4.00/4.00). Compare GF-22a and GF-22b: a stronger partner raises own team strength, so the same win earns p1 less.

cases.title: League-independence: League group
cases.description: GF-01 inputs played inside a League (league_id/community_id set). League identifiers are provenance only; rating outputs must equal GF-23b and GF-01.

cases.title: League-independence: no League
cases.description: GF-01 inputs, no League. Rating outputs must equal GF-23a.

cases.title: Claim-time level change allowed only without rated history
cases.description: p1 is provisional (creator estimate 3.0) with no rated history; at claim the player sets 3.5. Initialization is replaced (mu/display/highest 3.50, still 0 groups / 10%); no rating event. The following group rates from 3.50.

cases.title: Claim after rated history cannot change level
cases.description: p1 is provisional (creator estimate 3.0) and has one confirmed group. Claim succeeds with the same user_id but the requested 4.0 is rejected (level_change_applied false); only a PAF-17 Level Review may change it. State is unchanged by the claim.

cases.title: First creator-entered level wins
cases.description: p1 was created provisionally by a first creator at 3.0. A later adder proposes 4.5; the proposal is rejected and the original initialization persists. The subsequent group rates from 3.00.

cases.title: Near-equal Draw rounds to 0.00
cases.description: Team A (4.000) draws Team B (4.020), gap 0.02, all at 40%. The weaker team's evidence is real but tiny (raw ≈ ±0.0012) and rounds to 0.00 under the approved rule. Correct by design (flagged for review, not a defect): sub-cent evidence is not displayed; reliability and group count still advance.

invariants.compare: per-player raw_delta, rounded_delta, applied_delta, expected_score, team strengths and after-state (ignoring game_group_id, match_id, scores)
same as INV-margin, also ignoring league_id/community_id
same as INV-margin, also ignoring is_provisional/initialization_source

game_group steps only, in order; compare per player the rating state (mu, display_level, highest_display_level, sigma, reliability_percent, confirmed_competitive_game_groups, last_rating_at) and the rating event history; account_claim step emits no rating event; user_id identical; ignoring account-status metadata is_provisional
invariants.also_assert: account_claim changes only is_provisional (true to false) on the claimed player; no other state field and no rating event changes

invariants.compare: expected_final_state deep-equals initial_state; expected_rating_event_order is empty
